import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Filter the branches to check for 'main'
    await page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Filter by branch name").fill("main")
    # Wait for the page to update after filtering
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    # Check if 'main' branch link is present
    main_branch_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="main", exact=True)
    if await main_branch_link.count() > 0:
        await main_branch_link.click()
    else:
        # If 'main' not found, assume 'master' is the default and click it
        await page.get_by_role("link", name="master").click()
